dimensions.label: Identity and verification
dimensions.eligibility: Identity and account-ownership checks identify inconsistencies; they do not substitute for financial capacity.

dimensions.label: Ownership and control
dimensions.eligibility: Use documented beneficial ownership, control, guarantees and related-party exposure. Do not infer family relationships or hidden ownership.

dimensions.label: Cash flow
dimensions.eligibility: Use posted, deduplicated flows. Consolidation eliminates matched transfers; raw inflows remain distinct from operating receipts and revenue.

dimensions.label: Liquidity
dimensions.eligibility: Separate available, restricted and observed balances. Reconstructed daily balances require reconciled opening/closing balances and complete transaction coverage.

dimensions.label: Revenue quality
dimensions.eligibility: Distinguish accrual revenue, gross sales, refunds, taxes, fees and cash settlement. Financing, transfers and owner injections are not sales.

dimensions.label: Profitability
dimensions.eligibility: Align accounting basis, reporting scope and periods. EBITDA addbacks require itemized justification; never infer profit from deposits alone.

dimensions.label: Working capital
dimensions.eligibility: Use dated invoice/bill aging, sales and cost denominators on the same basis. Inventory valuation and credit-sales coverage must be explicit.

dimensions.label: Debt and leverage
dimensions.eligibility: Reconcile observed debt payments to disclosed and entitled bureau obligations. Unknown balances and undisclosed obligations are not zero.

dimensions.label: Repayment capacity
dimensions.eligibility: Use complete existing and proposed debt schedules, eligible cash flow and consistent periods. Include balloon and variable-payment terms.

dimensions.label: Concentration
dimensions.eligibility: Aggregate only resolved counterparties within the authorized borrower scope. Unknown counterparties remain a disclosed unallocated bucket.

dimensions.label: Collateral and security
dimensions.eligibility: Require current valuations, ownership, lien priority and permitted reports. This is collateral evidence, not a legal opinion or enforceability guarantee.

dimensions.label: Fraud and consistency
dimensions.eligibility: Signals identify evidence needing review; no signal or score alone confirms fraud. Preserve document locations and conflicting values.

dimensions.label: Income and affordability
dimensions.eligibility: Distinguish verified gross income, net deposits and modeled estimates. Include housing, essential spending, obligations and proposed payments without counting them twice.

dimensions.label: Income stability
dimensions.eligibility: Analyze authorized employment, self-employment and other recurring income streams separately. Income type is not itself an adverse risk reason.

dimensions.label: Payment behavior
dimensions.eligibility: Deduplicate returns and their fees. Report payment outcomes and timing rather than inferring missed payments from missing source coverage.

dimensions.label: Credit history
dimensions.eligibility: Use entitled credit reports with source, score model, pull time and coverage. No matched report is not a clean credit history.

dimensions.label: Commerce and subscriptions
dimensions.eligibility: Keep store/platform coverage, settlement lags and currency explicit. Cohort metrics require stable customer identifiers and a complete comparable cohort.

dimensions.label: Operating resilience
dimensions.eligibility: Measure payroll, supplier, inventory and fulfillment exposure from operational evidence. Do not infer management quality from personal traits or social media.

dimensions.label: Tax and statutory obligations
dimensions.eligibility: Separate declared, filed, assessed and paid amounts and their periods. Registration or filing evidence is not a legal or tax-compliance certification.

dimensions.label: Financial reporting quality
dimensions.eligibility: Measure statement coverage, closing lag, reconciliations and material adjustments; missing accounting records are not fabricated statements.

dimensions.label: Data quality and coverage
dimensions.eligibility: Describe observed coverage against declared/required sources; never imply visibility into all of a borrower's external accounts.

dimensions.label: Forecasting and stress
dimensions.eligibility: Separate scenario assumptions from observations. Forecasts require model/version, horizon and interval methodology; stress outcomes are conditional, not default probabilities.

dimensions.label: Related-party and network exposure
dimensions.eligibility: Only borrower-authorized ownership and transaction relationships are in scope. Links require evidence and uncertainty; no cross-institution identity graph is exposed.

dimensions.label: Monitoring changes
dimensions.eligibility: Compare compatible windows, scope, currencies and calculation versions. If comparability fails, expose the reason and no numeric delta.
